dct_title_s: Preliminary Satellite Derived Flood Evolution Assessment, Islamic Republic of Pakistan-19 October 2022
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20220808PAK, GDACS Id: 1101522** Status: Overall decrease of flood waters observed Further action(s): continue monitoring Summary of findings; Evolution of Cumulative Flood Waters over I.R. of Pakistan (03-09 October 2022 Vs 11-17 October 2022): Between 11 and 17 October 2022 approximately 11 million people remain potentially exposed or living close to flooded areas; Based on satellite observations between 03 and 09 October 2022 and compared with observations between 11 and 17 October 2022, the overall flood water extent appears to continue to decrease with approximately 200 km² in Balochistan, ~Punjab 100 km²  and  ~2,700 km² in Sindh.
